title: Balance Sheet
description: Point-in-time financial-statement contract for assets, liabilities, equity, and balance-check totals.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: fs-balance-sheet
  title: Balance Sheet
  description: Point-in-time financial-statement contract for extracting assets, liabilities, equity, and balance-check totals.
  version: 1.0.0
  source:
    system: ladder
    sourceId: standard-financial-services/balance-sheet
    sourceVersion: 1.0.0
spec:
  documentType: balance_sheet
  sections:
    - id: statement-identity
      title: Statement identity
      fieldIds: [entity-name, as-of-date, comparative-as-of-date, currency, scale, accounting-standard, audited]
    - id: assets
      title: Assets
      fieldIds: [cash-and-equivalents, accounts-receivable, inventory, other-current-assets, total-current-assets, property-plant-equipment, goodwill, intangible-assets, other-noncurrent-assets, total-assets]
    - id: liabilities
      title: Liabilities
      fieldIds: [accounts-payable, short-term-debt, other-current-liabilities, total-current-liabilities, long-term-debt, other-noncurrent-liabilities, total-liabilities]
    - id: equity-and-detail
      title: Equity and detail
      fieldIds: [common-stock, additional-paid-in-capital, retained-earnings, accumulated-other-comprehensive-income, treasury-stock, total-equity, total-liabilities-and-equity, line-items]
  fields:
    - id: entity-name
      name: entity_name
      label: Entity name
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /statement/entity_name
    - id: as-of-date
      name: as_of_date
      label: As-of date
      dataType: date
      required: true
      sourcePath: /statement/as_of_date
    - id: comparative-as-of-date
      name: comparative_as_of_date
      label: Comparative as-of date
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /statement/comparative_as_of_date
    - id: currency
      name: currency
      label: Reporting currency
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /statement/currency
    - id: scale
      name: scale
      label: Presentation scale
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /statement/scale
    - id: accounting-standard
      name: accounting_standard
      label: Accounting standard
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /statement/accounting_standard
    - id: audited
      name: audited
      label: Audited
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /statement/audited
    - id: cash-and-equivalents
      name: cash_and_equivalents
      label: Cash and cash equivalents
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /assets/cash_and_equivalents
    - id: accounts-receivable
      name: accounts_receivable
      label: Accounts receivable
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /assets/accounts_receivable
    - id: inventory
      name: inventory
      label: Inventory
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /assets/inventory
    - id: other-current-assets
      name: other_current_assets
      label: Other current assets
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /assets/other_current_assets
    - id: total-current-assets
      name: total_current_assets
      label: Total current assets
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /assets/total_current_assets
    - id: property-plant-equipment
      name: property_plant_equipment
      label: Property, plant, and equipment
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /assets/property_plant_equipment
    - id: goodwill
      name: goodwill
      label: Goodwill
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /assets/goodwill
    - id: intangible-assets
      name: intangible_assets
      label: Intangible assets
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /assets/intangible_assets
    - id: other-noncurrent-assets
      name: other_noncurrent_assets
      label: Other noncurrent assets
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /assets/other_noncurrent_assets
    - id: total-assets
      name: total_assets
      label: Total assets
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /assets/total_assets
    - id: accounts-payable
      name: accounts_payable
      label: Accounts payable
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /liabilities/accounts_payable
    - id: short-term-debt
      name: short_term_debt
      label: Short-term debt
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /liabilities/short_term_debt
    - id: other-current-liabilities
      name: other_current_liabilities
      label: Other current liabilities
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /liabilities/other_current_liabilities
    - id: total-current-liabilities
      name: total_current_liabilities
      label: Total current liabilities
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /liabilities/total_current_liabilities
    - id: long-term-debt
      name: long_term_debt
      label: Long-term debt
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /liabilities/long_term_debt
    - id: other-noncurrent-liabilities
      name: other_noncurrent_liabilities
      label: Other noncurrent liabilities
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /liabilities/other_noncurrent_liabilities
    - id: total-liabilities
      name: total_liabilities
      label: Total liabilities
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /liabilities/total_liabilities
    - id: common-stock
      name: common_stock
      label: Common stock
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /equity/common_stock
    - id: additional-paid-in-capital
      name: additional_paid_in_capital
      label: Additional paid-in capital
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /equity/additional_paid_in_capital
    - id: retained-earnings
      name: retained_earnings
      label: Retained earnings
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /equity/retained_earnings
    - id: accumulated-other-comprehensive-income
      name: accumulated_other_comprehensive_income
      label: Accumulated other comprehensive income
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /equity/accumulated_other_comprehensive_income
    - id: treasury-stock
      name: treasury_stock
      label: Treasury stock
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /equity/treasury_stock
    - id: total-equity
      name: total_equity
      label: Total equity
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /equity/total_equity
    - id: total-liabilities-and-equity
      name: total_liabilities_and_equity
      label: Total liabilities and equity
      dataType: number
      required: true
      sourcePath: /totals/total_liabilities_and_equity
    - id: line-items
      name: line_items
      label: Statement line items
      description: Ordered balance-sheet line items with current and comparative values and source location when available.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /line_items
  validationRules:
    - id: entity-name-present
      severity: error
      description: The reporting entity is required.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: entity_name }
    - id: as-of-date-present
      severity: error
      description: The balance-sheet date is required.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: as_of_date }
    - id: total-assets-present
      severity: error
      description: Total assets are required.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: total_assets }
    - id: total-liabilities-and-equity-present
      severity: error
      description: Total liabilities and equity are required.
      supported: true
      rule: { op: present, field: total_liabilities_and_equity }
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.85
    fieldConfidence:
      as_of_date: { minConfidence: 0.95, reviewOnBreach: true }
      total_assets: { minConfidence: 0.9, reviewOnBreach: true }
      total_liabilities: { minConfidence: 0.9, reviewOnBreach: true }
      total_equity: { minConfidence: 0.9, reviewOnBreach: true }
      total_liabilities_and_equity: { minConfidence: 0.9, reviewOnBreach: true }
  outputSchema: {}
